video_title: Coach Tony Parker Has a Message For His Doubters

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on Gregg Popovich's coaching advice
quotes.excerpt: he will say be better than me, because that's what he told me when I started my career
quotes.quote: I won't know what he say. He will say be better than me, because that's what he told me when I started my career. Obviously, he is somebody that helped me a lot during my career. He was one of the first person, him and my dad, the first person that I told that I wanted to become a coach and I wanted to transition. I felt like I'm missing that adrenaline and I want to compete on the everyday basis. I was missing my old life and I felt like I have a lot of stuff that I can give with my basketball mind. So if Pop came in, he will say just try to be better than me.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on the importance of energy and defense
quotes.excerpt: Pop will always go crazy if you don't play with energy and play defense
quotes.quote: Pop will always go crazy if you don't play with energy and play defense because it's two things you can always control. He will always say control what you can control. If you miss a shot or you dribble off your foot, that stuff we can't control, that's basketball. But energy and playing defense, you can always do that.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on the importance of family atmosphere in coaching
quotes.excerpt: I think the family atmosphere, how close we are to our players
quotes.quote: I think the family atmosphere, how close we are to our players. They are in the center of my project and I want to make sure it's our job to put them in the best position to be as successful as they can. Because at the end of the day, they are the one on the court performing. You can try to inspire them, but it has to come from them and build it together.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on Victor Wembanyama as a complete player
quotes.excerpt: I will go with Victor Wembanyama. He is the most complete player
quotes.quote: I will go with Victor Wembanyama. He is the most complete player. He plays at both ends of the courts and he is young, he is going to keep improving. So if I had to choose one player, I will go with him.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on Victor Wembanyama's leadership by example
quotes.excerpt: he challenges his coaches and his teammates, and he wants to lead by example
quotes.quote: The thing I like is he challenges his coaches and his teammates, and he wants to lead by example too. And as a coach, that's what you want. You want a player who is going to translate your philosophy the best way you can. And I think he is the type of player, he plays with his brain and he wants to understand why we are doing stuff.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on his coaching philosophy regarding intentional fouls
quotes.excerpt: I am from that school because I played in Europe for so long
quotes.quote: I am from that school because I played in Europe for so long, that's the philosophy in Europe. Yeah, I will foul. But at the time back then in NBA, you don't really foul, you play defense and you trust your defense. And at the time we had one of the best defense in NBA and that's what we decided and me, I respect the coach decision.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on building a team culture through player trust
quotes.excerpt: the most important is that the players trust your process, trust your culture
quotes.quote: I think you can pick a little bit of everything. I don't think it's just one that's perfect. I think the most important is that the players trust your process, trust your culture, trust what you want to put in place. Like that, you as a coach, once we agree that we built this and that's what we are going to do, you can hold them accountable. I think that's the most important thing whatever you choose.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on watching top teams to learn winning habits
quotes.excerpt: I will watch the top teams because for me it's a reason why they are at the top
quotes.quote: I will watch the top teams because for me it's a reason why they are at the top. It's a reason why teams win close games because if you look at it, the EuroLeague is very, very tight. Every team is very close. Every game it can go either way. We have been in those games already against Valencia and Belgrade, it could have gone either way. And so me, I like to watch the big teams. Obviously yes the big teams they have more talent maybe or stuff like that, but at the end of the day it's a reason why they win those close games.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on the difference in game tempo between NBA and EuroLeague
quotes.excerpt: I think they control the tempo a little bit better
quotes.quote: I think they control the tempo a little bit better. It's not better meaning like they want to control the tempo more. I will put it like that, because in NBA it goes up and down, up and down, up and down. So that's why in NBA when you go up 20 or up 25, you never safe. And I was very surprised that Olympiacos the way they came back against Valencia, that's very rare in the EuroLeague because we have a tendency to control the tempo more, to control the momentum and all that kind of stuff.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on his desired legacy as a player
quotes.excerpt: I was a winner, that I wanted to win, that I was discipline
quotes.quote: I think same as a player, that I was a winner, that I wanted to win, that I was discipline, that my work ethic was at the highest level and that they can trust me and trust the process that we decided to put together. That'd be I think the best compliment and that we were winning. You always want to be remembered as a winner.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on his goal to win with ASVEL
quotes.excerpt: my big big big dream is to win with ASVEL
quotes.quote: My big big big dream is to win with ASVEL. I would love to bring ASVEL back in a Final Four. Last time we went in a Final Four was 97, so it's a long time ago. And obviously off the court, it's a lot of stuff we have to to improve, but I'm a big believer. I feel like my country is in an unbelievable place, we have great players everywhere and most of those players they would love to stay in France. So we just have to do a better job to try to get more sponsors and funds and stuff like that to invest in France.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on his approach to dealing with critics
quotes.excerpt: I prefer to be the person that is doing something that the people that just criticizing
quotes.quote: I prefer to be the person that is doing something that the people that just criticizing and not doing anything. That's easy to criticize, everybody does that, that's easy. But the people that's trying to move stuff, you know when you're a pioneer, you always get criticized at the beginning because people they don't see it or they don't have your vision or they don't want to change or stuff like that. But when you people wants to make stuff happen, you just have to be patient and just have to keep believing. And so with me, I don't care about people criticizing. I got they criticize since I'm 19 years old.
